players.note: I'm a LaPorta fan, but his TE4 price tag is a bit expensive for me. You can likely get an even bigger premium now that he's past his bye week. I just don't feel he brings that much value over replacement at his position.
Three straight games of three or fewer receptions for Fannin. He's no longer startable, and I'm ready to hop off this train. I don't see him bouncing back enough to truly burn me if I sell low.

Juwan has come back to earth the past two weeks...hang tight and wait for another big performance before shopping him. Hopefully it comes before Jordyn Tyson returns, as he'll move down the totem pole at that point.

I'm sure the volume and efficiency will pick back up once Lamar returns, but I'm afraid Andrews isn't any good anymore. He's so slow, stiff, and really struggles in any sort of contested-catch situation.

Michael Mayer is legit. Don't let Brock Bowers being listed at the same position deter you from investing in Mayer. Bowers is essentially a WR listed as a TE. Mayer is the true TE and the second option in this
 passing attack.
